summary.result: Thermal balance was a important factor for an optimum ventilation up to the external temperature of $32^{circ}C$ , while $CO_{2}$ concentration balance was more important over $32^{circ}C$ .
summary.background: In this study, a ventilation model was developed to determine a ventilation rate for the balance of heat, moisture and $CO_{2}$ in a mushroom house.
summary.method: The verified model was simulated under the observed ventilation rates with a difference of $ 0.001{\~}0.065\;m^{3}{\cdot}S^{-1}$ (relative error of $0.3{\~}18.9\%$ ) when external temperature varied 22.5 to $24.8^{circ}C$ and average ventilation rates was $0.35m^{3}{\cdot}S^{-1}$ .
